transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you start by telling me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me?

Um, yeah… I guess I’m here because I’m having a hard time keeping things organized. It’s probably not, like, the worst thing ever, but it’s starting to get in the way.

I’m trying to keep up with schoolwork, and I also have this little accessories shop, and somehow all the supplies, due dates, receipts, and notes for assignments just end up in piles. Then I look at everything and I don’t really know what I’m supposed to do first. I feel kind of embarrassed saying that, because I should probably be able to manage it better, but… yeah, that’s mostly why I came in.
Would you say you've struggled with staying organized and focused like this since you were a kid, or is this more of a new problem that started recently?

I think it’s been there since I was little, honestly. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, because I did understand the work and I wasn’t trying to be difficult or anything… but my mom still has some notes from elementary school saying I was out of my seat a lot, or I’d talk before being called on.

There were also comments about me rushing through group activities, even when I knew what I was doing. So… yeah, I guess it’s not totally new. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about various things in your daily life, more days than not, and having trouble controlling that worry?

I don’t think so… not like constant worry, I mean. I get stressed about school or when things pile up, but I wouldn’t say I’m worrying all day about lots of different things.

Unless I’m misunderstanding what counts as “excessive”? I just don’t think that’s the main thing for me.
In the past six months, do you often find yourself feeling restless, fidgeting, or having trouble staying seated or waiting your turn in situations like meetings or lines?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, because I can usually keep it together enough, but even when I’m just sitting there, it’s like my body feels kind of… buzzy? Like I need to be moving somehow.

It’s especially when I’m supposed to sit still and listen. I’ll shift around or feel like I’m waiting for it to be over, even if I’m trying to pay attention. Is that what you mean?
Would you say these organization and restlessness issues have caused real problems in more than one area of your life—like both school and your shop, or also in your relationships or home life?

Yeah… I think it has, unfortunately. I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s starting to have actual consequences.

With school, I missed some required steps for my program, and now my financial aid is kind of at risk, which is… embarrassing to say. And with shop projects, people have started relying on me less because I guess they’re not sure I’ll keep track of everything or follow through the way I’m supposed to.

So, yes, I think it’s more than just me being a little scattered. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Do you often find it hard to stay focused on tasks—like losing track of what you're doing, making careless mistakes, or getting easily distracted—when you're working on schoolwork or shop tasks?

Yeah… I do notice that. I can start out really trying to listen, like in class or if I’m watching a video for one of my business assignments, and I’ll be following it at first.

But then after a few minutes my brain kind of drifts off to, like, charm designs or order ideas, and then I realize I missed a whole chunk of what was said. I don’t mean to do it, and sometimes I don’t even notice right away. So… yeah, staying focused can be hard for me, if that’s what you mean.
